channel.title: indiek — Music from Korea, worth sharing
channel.description: Stories, artist introductions and listening guides from indiek.

item.title: gongwon — Flower
item.description: gongwon’s “Flower” follows someone who wants to keep growing, even when they dislike what they see in themselves. It appears on the EP 0, also featured in the live session below.

item.title: Yebit — Only You
item.description: Yebit’s releases include Dancing With You, Home and the EP 23. Here, her performance of “Only You” follows someone trying to hide how much a relationship still matters.

item.title: Inside sunwoojunga’s “Run with Me”
item.description: A trip taken alone became an offer to go together. The story behind “도망가자”, and the expectations that followed it onto the stage.

item.title: Where to go after Yerin Baek’s “0310”
item.description: The writing process behind tellusboutyourself offers a route from “0310” to her next album.

item.title: Yerin Baek — 0310
item.description: Yerin Baek is a singer-songwriter whose music spans R&B, pop and rock. Alongside her solo work, she helped form the rock band The Volunteers.

item.title: Korean indie: where to start
item.description: Korean songs worth sharing, with live performances, artist stories and more music to try.
